correctness.rationale: The state space comprises all 6240 unordered factorizations of the fixed 28-edge K8, enumerated exhaustively by canonical first-uncovered-edge recursion and independently by team-zero color-class anchoring. Two methods independently identify all 4-cycle switches (two-component matchings versus four-team subset exchanges). Every listed edge is a legal switch, all legal switches are generated, and every nontrivial component vertex is a BFS root for computing eccentricity. Independently generated 6240 states and 17640 edge certificates share both SHA256 hashes (states 544c02ebaa1e834f533f4e04aa3b8524b517d46fbc5900c8d72d43e70e36e9f3; edges 278543195bffe9e837bb1ed4358cc87cabb4b2ac7929b06a24e6c4bcbc253c4a). Full counts have been checked, with no infinite extrapolation.

originality.rationale: The known paper explicitly computes the switching graph on the SIX vertex-unlabeled isomorphism classes, including its isolated perfect-factorization class; the known 6240 count and isolation criterion are excluded from the claimed original contribution. The present theorem computes the full 6240-state vertex-labeled graph, in particular one 5280-state component and its 11-step diameter and complete eccentricity profile. Lifts of quotient paths can end at arbitrary relabelings and thus quotient connectivity/distances do not entail these exact fixed-label results. Targeted source, alias, and parameter checks found no dominating full labeled computation; possible unindexed data are a residual risk.

value.rationale: The eight-team complete round robin is the first even complete graph with multiple unlabeled one-factorizations, and fixed participant identity makes the labeled switch graph the natural space. The published six-class quotient cannot establish actual schedules reachable without relabeling or the sharp maximum 11 exchange moves. A complete 5280-state connected component and exact radius, diameter, degrees and eccentricities constitute a natural finite structural benchmark; the 960 isolated schedules exhibit a genuine local-mobility obstruction. This is mathematically motivated rather than a random parameter slice or recomputation of the known 6240 count.
